findings.title: Customer requests a fall program review session with clinic managers
findings.description: Marcus asks whether there is anything on the program side to think about; Priya confirms engagement is healthy with no issues flagged. Marcus then asks to schedule a deeper program review with his clinic managers, to happen in the fall after renewal, ideally in person. This is a customer-success service engagement (a business review meeting), not a defect in or missing capability of the BetterBark product itself.
findings.quote: Maybe in the fall, after renewal, when I'm not staring at a finance committee. A program review with the clinic managers might be useful
findings.severity_reason: No product defect or missing capability is described; this is a scheduling/services request with no technical impact.
findings.match_note: Not present in catalogue; it is a services/CSM engagement request, not a product bug or feature, so it does not map to any tracked issue.

findings.title: Customer requests the fall program review be conducted in person
findings.description: Following the program-review scheduling request, Marcus separately asks if the review could be done in person if Priya is ever in the region, noting clinic managers would engage better face-to-face than over a screen. This is a request about the format/delivery of a customer-success meeting, not a BetterBark product feature or defect.
findings.quote: the fall program review with the clinic managers. Can we do it in person if you're ever out this way? They'd get more out of a face than a screen.
findings.severity_reason: Purely a logistics/format preference for a services meeting; no product impact.
